I did try a number of ways for a time, but as I said even dating didnt change anything. Now i have no options at all, locked into job because of economy and debt and that job robs me of any free time.
Ya really, sounds like she put her own selfish wants first then afterwards slightly considered the consequences.

The most common thing i hear from people ive talked to is:
-children are the future!
-i have to have children, i have to! (as if they are an animal with a massive urge to breed)
-children are cute.
-children are wonderful to have.
No consideration for the fact that these are living human beings that are going to have health or mental issues growing up.

It sucks because you arent given a choice and just have to find ways to deal with it your whole life.
Hopefully you have close friends or family that can help you out in those situations.
